name: Fuyuiro Denshin
source:
Main character attends school on a boring winter day. But this day he encounters a mysterious person, and the world around protagonist starts to change rapidly. Will there be warmth of someone else by the end of winter vacations?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在一个无聊的冬日，主人公照常去上学。然而这一天，他遇见了一名神秘人物，周围世界也开始迅速改变。寒假结束时，他能否感受到来自另一个人的温暖？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
